name: faq-founder
title: Founder FAQ
description: A dark FAQ page with a small centred heading. On the left a card introduces the founder with a photo, quote and blue LinkedIn button; on the right a stack of dark panels opens and closes one question at a time.
use: An about or pricing page wants FAQs next to a short founder bio and a contact link.
avoid: Only six fixed questions and one profile photo, and the dark palette with the blue button is hardcoded.
a11y: Questions are real buttons with aria-expanded and a linked region, but the open animation ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Charcoal page with a small centred heading. The left card holds a small square portrait, a bold name, a grey role, a quoted line and a blue rounded button with a LinkedIn mark. Right of it sit six rounded near-black rows, each with a question and a pale square holding a plus or minus; open rows show a grey paragraph.
behaves: Entering the section reveals the heading, profile card and questions in a stagger. Clicking a question swaps its plus for a minus and slides the answer open with a short height animation; several rows can be open at once.
customise: The six questions, answers, founder name, quote and photo path are hardcoded; colours and the LinkedIn URL need source edits.
weight: light: Six short height animations on click and a one-time entrance; otherwise idle.
demo: Founder "Naymur Rahman" with questions about what the product solves and who it suits.
issues: The accordion rows are almost the same charcoal as the page, so their edges are barely visible.
In the first frame the question column is empty until the entrance animation runs.
polishWhy: Clean accordion layout, but the dark cards barely separate from the page and answers are small.
